I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is **261**.

- **Where 261 comes from:** Ilse posted it in #north-team on Oct 14. Dana is in that channel, so she can see it herself.
- **Not 185:** the 185 seats in that channel from August 2025 was Amendment No. 1, not the renewal. I said so to head off confusion in the tracker.
- **Renewal date:** a public North team note from March 2026 says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20.
- **Not checked against the contract:** I haven't seen the signed renewal itself, so 261 rests on Ilse's post. I told Dana that Ilse can confirm it if the tracker needs the contract as the source.

One problem from last time: my wrap-up note about Ilse's message was posted into #north-team as a separate message, not just as my reply here. It doesn't say anything that wasn't already in the channel, but it shouldn't have gone there.
